newsitem.title: MEXICO: Brady oil payment seen more likely - Mexico official.
newsitem.headline: Brady oil payment seen more likely - Mexico official.

text.p: Financial markets believe the probability that Mexico will have to make warrant payments on some of its Brady bonds tied to the price of oil has "increased," a government official said on Friday.
"The market believes the probability that a payment will have to be made has increased," the official, who declined to be identified, said.
Any supplemental payments that may have to be made to some of the Brady bond holders would only be between $2.0 to $7.0 million in December, the government official said.
